name: RoboWorld
summary: Presents 25 simulations of economically valuable physical work, selected using U.S. GDP data and constructed by coding agents through an adversarial creation and audit loop.
numbers: 25 test and 175 training environments; best frontier models fail every test task, mean reward 0.06

why.cx: Varied difficulty, up to hard test tasks.
why.xr: Tracks capability at economically valuable physical work, a precursor of displacement; does not measure the threat itself.
